additional_info.subject: ID0435644-DC/Si-D/DK-[Y2 / S3 300000007014] Converter_Group_DC3+DC4 error CRM:02919000112
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus,
Since we are working with Dispenser + Main charger, the contactors responsible for the fastshutdown QA36-QA40 are not used, so we can remove them out of the equation.
We need to understand from the dispenser's StateMonitor if the 12V is coming properly and reaching the converters in the main charger.
I would recommend following that whole line:
We should see the 12V being applied when the Fastshutdown is being performed.
Up until here:
The idea is the same for the 2nd connector.
Please check if these connections are done properly from the dispenser, is it possible that there are some swapped cables?
It's also possible that on this XD9.2B/A, those nasty orange connectors, is a bit loose and cause disconnection.
I will send this ticket to you since we need to check on-site. Please bring a spare KF214.
If you need support on-site to check the DebugStation, please schedule with at least 1 day in advance to prepare my calendar.
Thanks and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
